about.label: About
about.title: Jakub Kurdziel, Web Developer
about.intro: For over five years I have been designing, delivering and maintaining websites and web applications. I work with clients of varying scale, from sole proprietors to larger business entities. I value precise communication of requirements and consistent delivery within agreed timelines.
about.intro2: I recommend solutions adequate to real business needs and scale. I deliver both simple business landing pages and complex systems with multiple integrations, always within a scope that supports your specific business goals.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Did not find an answer to your question? Please feel free to get in touch directly.

items.q: How much does a website cost?
items.a: A business landing page costs PLN 299. Larger projects are quoted individually following an initial conversation. Every client receives a complete quote before work begins, with no hidden costs.

A business landing page is delivered within 48 hours of finalising requirements and receiving the materials (logo, copy, photographs). Larger projects typically take 1 to 4 weeks. Timelines are set realistically and consistently met.

items.q: Are hosting and domain included in the price?
items.a: The Business landing page package includes the first year of hosting and domain. Subsequent annual maintenance costs approximately PLN 100 to 200, depending on the chosen domain. Deployment to client-owned hosting is also possible.

items.q: Can I edit the content myself after launch?
items.a: Yes. Training on editing the key sections of the website is included as standard. Implementation of a CMS panel (for example for blog management) is delivered as part of a custom quote.

items.q: Do you also handle SEO optimisation?
items.a: Yes. Every project includes basic SEO optimisation (meta tags, sitemap, structured data, Core Web Vitals). Advanced ranking work and content marketing are offered as separate services.

Next.js, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. Websites are fast, well-indexed by search engines and easy to extend further. For simpler projects WordPress is also available. The technology choice always reflects the specific project requirements.
